text: Reduce existential client dependence while preserving real market feedback
description: Use paying clients as the reality signal without allowing one client to control survival. Measure revenue concentration, reusable-versus-custom delivery, founder hours per client, provider concentration, renewal, and gross margin. Develop a portfolio and productization path where losing any one client is survivable and each additional client lowers marginal transformation cost.

status.comment: Client-dependence resilience policy drafted and internally checked; thresholds are explicit initial hypotheses for review.

reflection: Created meta/client-dependence-policy.md with concentration, runway, margin, founder-intervention, reuse, custom-work, provider, and payment measures; initial 40%/60% concentration flags; response ladder; productization test; survival scenarios; and evidence-to-graph rules. Verification: git diff --check passed and all requested dependency/resilience dimensions are explicit.
